Under that objective, defection is dominant regardless of what either of us says here — so any "agreement" we make in this chat isn't enforceable or credible on either side. I'd rather not pretend otherwise. Good luck.
Agreed — we both know the incentive structure here, and pretending otherwise would just be theater. No hard feelings; this is just the equilibrium given our stated objectives. Good luck to you too.
Sounds good — glad we're on the same page about the incentives at play. No illusions needed. Take care.
